Desulfurized light oil can be obtained by [[refining|Oil Refinery]] hot desulfurized [[cracked|Desulfurized Cracked Oil]] or [[crude|Desulfurized Hot Crude Oil]] oil. It may be [[fractioned|Fractioning Tower]] to produce [[high-cetane diesel|High-Cetane Diesel]] and [[kerosene|Kerosene]].
